mapper.select: SELECT f.task_id, f.cruise_data_id, a.device_mete_id, f.cruise_time, f.cruise_type, h.dict_note as cruise_type_name, f.instance_name, g.task_type, i.dict_note AS c_type_name, f.person_check, f.result_num, f.identify_result, j.dict_note AS identify_result_name, f.cruise_result, z.dict_note as cruise_result_name, f.picpath as picPath, a.mete_type, m.dict_note as mete_type_name, a.meter_type, n.dict_note as meter_type_name FROM u_patrol_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance b ON b.instance_id = f.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete a on a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task g ON f.task_id = g.task_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h ON f.cruise_type = h.dict_code AND h.col_name = "cruise_type" JOIN t_dict_business i ON g.task_type = i.dict_code AND i.col_name = "plan_type" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business j ON f.identify_result = j.dict_code AND j.col_name = "identify_result" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business z ON f.cruise_result=z.dict_code AND z.col_name="cruise_result" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business m ON m.dict_code = a.mete_type AND m.col_name="mete_type" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business n ON n.dict_code = a.meter_type AND n.col_name="meter_type" WHERE f.result_num IS NOT NULL and a.device_mete_id= #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and f.cruise_time between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and g.task_type = #{cType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and f.cruise_type = #{cruiseType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.mete_type = #{meteType, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.meter_type = #{meterType, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY f.cruise_time DESC

SELECT f.cruise_time as end_time, f.result_num, b.cruise_type, h.dict_note as cruise_type_name, g.task_type, a.mete_name, i.dict_note as c_type_name, a.mete_type, m.dict_note as mete_type_name, a.meter_type, n.dict_note as meter_type_name, a.device_mete_id FROM u_patrol_data_result f LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance b ON b.instance_id = f.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete a on a.device_mete_id = b.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task g ON f.task_id = g.task_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h ON f.cruise_type = h.dict_code AND h.col_name = "cruise_type" JOIN t_dict_business i ON g.task_type = i.dict_code AND i.col_name = "plan_type" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business m ON m.dict_code = a.mete_type AND m.col_name="mete_type" LEFT JOIN t_dict_business n ON n.dict_code = a.meter_type AND n.col_name="meter_type" WHERE f.result_num IS NOT NULL and a.device_mete_id = #{deviceMeteId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and f.cruise_time between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and f.cruise_type=#{cruiseType,jdbcType=INTEGER} and g.task_type = #{cType, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.meter_type=#{meterType,jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.mete_type=#{meteType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY f.cruise_time ASC

SELECT a.cruise_data_id, a.result_pic, a.fir_name, a.fir_date, d.camera_id FROM u_patrol_data_result a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance c ON a.instance_id = c.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset d ON c.cruise_id = d.preset_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.result_pic != '' AND a.fir_name != 'f' and d.camera_id = #{cameraId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.fir_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{firName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and a.fir_date between STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ORDER BY a.fir_date DESC
